consumerMigration: ADR-0005 introduces manifest format 2 and explicit canonical exports before first distribution. Consumers must distinguish contractPublication, implementationConformance and deploymentCompliance. Existing diagnostic exports and canonical wire/schema/operation semantics are unchanged. Protected paths stay excluded without bindings; the inventory and known limitations remain normative. Empty supportedCapabilities conveys no implementation claim. D05/D08 remain host-conformance blockers. First distribution remains 0.0.1 under ADR-0004.
rollback: Before first publication, revert the canonical artifact/gate change together and regenerate prior review artifacts. After distribution, fix forward with compatibility review and preserve immutable versions and existing exports. Never restore unsafe Forms behavior, waive P07, weaken host evidence or introduce another versioner.
